column1: Estimator chosen by the fixed rule: DEA, constant returns to scale (RTS = 3)

Inputs: research staff (faculty + fellows + PhD students) and deflated current costs, t-1; output: Scopus publications in t. Research staff = faculty + research fellows + PhD students (changed on 28 November 2026 after the instructor's request of 27 November to include PhD students with researchers). The input measures research capacity; the exposure stays students / faculty because it measures teaching. One aggregated labour input keeps p + q = 3 with n = 183. Faculty only (previous main) is R9 in g4/13.
Pooled frontier: each university appears three times, so observations are not independent; tests and subsampling treat them as independent.
Scopus indexing may be incomplete for recent years: 2023 may look less efficient (SFA year effects in 06 about -0.05 in 2022 and -0.11 in 2023); g4/13 estimates one frontier per year as a check.
Main analysis keeps all observations; the version without the ap potential outliers is a robustness check in g4/13.

ap rule (mechanical): every observation that appears in any of the 12 deletion sets of ap (NDEL = 12) is flagged as a potential outlier, hence at least 12 are flagged by construction; here 13 university-years of 6 universities.

ap separation: gap_to_next = ratio[2,i] - ratio[1,i], the distance between the best and the next-best deletion set for i deletions (the gap visible in ap.plot). Largest gaps: i = 3 (0.0678) and i = 4 (0.0414); median gap over i = 1-12: 0.0107.

Subsampling intervals lie above the estimate: the lower bound is >= the estimated Farrell score in 183 of 183 cases. This is expected: the DEA CRS estimate is biased towards efficiency (estimated Farrell <= true Farrell in the output orientation), while the interval is for the true Farrell score and already corrects for that bias.

Unstable intervals (chosen subsample size m < 10 at 95%; column ci_unstable_m_lt_10): 51 of 183; by year 2021: 16, 2022: 18, 2023: 17; 31 universities, of which 4 in all three years (Calabria, Catanzaro, Insubria, Verona). Read these intervals with caution.
Fast tests (NSPLIT = 1000) give reject/not-reject decisions at 10/5/1%; failing to reject H0 is not evidence that H0 is true.
Efficiency is relative to the observed best practice in this sample: it is not overall university quality.
